concerns.text: T001 instructs excluding 'rows with missing critical features (targets or required descriptors)' but no task ever computes the structural descriptors (atomic_radius, packing_fraction) that FR-001 and plan.md Phase-1 step 3 require via pymatgen CIF parsing. The implementer cannot determine what the 'required descriptors' are or produce them; the exclusion logic and the PCA input feature set are therefore unexecutable as specified. Add a descriptor-computation step (or a documented decision to use composition-only features) to T001.

T005 requires calibration_summary.csv to conform to calibration_metric.schema.yaml, whose method enum is ['deep_ensemble','mc_dropout','sparse_gp'], while T003's prediction CSVs and best_uq_method.txt use 'ensemble'. An implementer following both tasks literally produces files that fail each other's validation. Specify one canonical method-name mapping (e.g., emit 'deep_ensemble' in calibration_summary.csv) so the verification is executable.

T005's verification requires ece_cv per method, but T002 trains the ensemble once (fixed member seeds 42–46) and T003 runs Sparse GP 'seed-independent, run once and reused'. Per-seed ECE exists only for MC-Dropout, so ece_cv for ensemble and sparse_gp is either undefined or computed from identical values (CV=0, vacuous). Specify how per-seed variation is actually produced (e.g., retrain ensemble member subsets per robustness seed, or vary GP inducing-point initialization) or the SC-004 evidence cannot be generated.

T003 writes both per-seed files results/uq_predictions_seed_<seed>.csv and per-method files results/predictions/uq_predictions_*.csv without stating which seed the per-method files correspond to or whether they are seed-aggregated; prediction_output.schema.yaml has no seed column. Specify the provenance (e.g., per-method files = seed 42, or mean across seeds) so the file contents are deterministic.

The Timeout unit test is specified as 'a sleep past the limit triggers the exception' against the 5-hour limit from config.yaml. As written the test either takes 5 hours or cannot be implemented literally. Specify a test-mode short limit (e.g., Timeout(seconds=0.1) constructor parameter) so the test is executable.

FR-005's 'reconstruction variance' is tasked as an output but neither plan.md, data-model.md, nor T003 defines how it is computed (PCA reconstruction error? GP posterior variance at inducing points?). The implementer cannot produce a deterministic artifact from this description. Define the formula or reference in T003.

T001 hard-codes 20 PCA components AND asserts cumulative explained variance ≥ 0.90, while plan.md says 'retain >90% variance' with free component count. If 20 components are insufficient on the real feature set, the task gives no resolution order. Specify: choose the smallest component count meeting ≥0.90 (capped at 20) or similar.

Constitution Principle VI mandates training ≤30 min and UQ evaluation ≤20 min per property, but T007 only measures and enforces the 5-hour total. Add per-stage timing capture (training wall-clock, evaluation wall-clock) to runtime_report.json so the sub-budgets are verifiable.
